title: Build a health-aware router
summary: A router sends work to a server that can handle it. A health check lets it skip unavailable servers instead of repeatedly sending requests to them.
example: With servers A (down), B (healthy), and C (healthy), request indexes 0, 1, 2 go to B, C, B.
takeaway: Filter healthy servers first; apply round-robin to that filtered list.
instruction: Return the id of a healthy server using requestIndex modulo the number of healthy servers. Preserve input order. Return null if none are healthy. Inputs use a nonnegative integer index.
hint: Filter healthy servers first; apply round-robin to that filtered list.
